map.本工具能替代医师诊断吗？: Can this tool replace a doctor's diagnosis?
map.不能，仅作描述模板，分期以创面专科评估为准。: No, it is only a description template; staging is decided by a wound care specialist assessment.
map.1 期与 2 期如何区分？: How are stage 1 and stage 2 distinguished?
map.1 期皮肤完整红斑不退，2 期已破损达真皮，关键看皮肤完整性。: In stage 1 the skin is intact with non-blanching erythema; in stage 2 it is broken through to the dermis. The key is skin integrity.
map.深部组织损伤为何难判？: Why is deep tissue injury hard to judge?
map.表皮可完好但皮下已坏死，需持续观察颜色、温度、硬度变化。: The epidermis can be intact while the tissue beneath is already necrotic, so colour, temperature and hardness changes must be observed continuously.
